All the demographics are computed using Elections Electoral Roll of Melaka 2026 Elections and checked against EC's infographics on state level composition. Ethnic Composition data is an estimate as there is no public official document by SPR for ethnic make-up of Melaka's voter roll. There is a minor discrepancy between voter count by age groups at the state level between Tindak Malaysia's electoral roll computation and EC's infographics TindakMalaysia Network Services (refer to table below).
